Method of Attack: Exploitation of critical severity bugs allowing unauthenticated users to gain administrator privileges or log in as administrator
Database deletion flaw allowing attacker to delete site's entire database
Administrator registration vulnerability exploited via crafted requests to create new admin accounts
Uploading malicious scripts through plugin and theme uploaders in WordPress dashboard
Injecting malicious code in legitimate JavaScript files to redirect visitors to malicious sites
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites running vulnerable versions of ThemeGrill Demo Importer and Profile Builder plugins
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched vulnerabilities in WordPress plugins
Sending crafted HTTP requests to vulnerable plugin endpoints
Uploading malicious scripts via WordPress plugin and theme uploaders
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious script filenames: blockspluginn.php, wp-block-plugin.php, supersociall.php, wp-hello-plugin.php
Injected malicious code in legitimate JavaScript files
Requests containing new administrator account details (username, email, profile details)
